The full-site class is attained at R = 5: 2,210,000 multisets of five rounds induce the code (1, 1, 5) at the target site, and the witness this unit exhibits leaves 13 of its 27 cells at zero.
The covering floor is R = 6, and the structurally live covering floor is R = 7.

Under the Born menu the indefinite mass is 146623744/847288609443 against 148895641/90632341800 under the uniform-on-support counting measure on the same tree: AVOIDED.
Under the record menu the indefinite mass is 5072320/1162261467 against 53/34992: SELECTED.
